title: CaseParty
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.casework.CaseParty). A party on ONE case. `party_reference` is a per-case handle minted by epd2_compliance_service.casework.mint_case_party_reference: it is meaningless, never reused across cases, and resolvable to a person by no service in this repository (Framework hard invariant 1, 'no global user ID'). `is_authorized_service_recipient` is the single fact that governs whether an official notice may be validly addressed to this party. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
